function: Q-learning chooses only the UAV trajectory (pp. 6-7); transmit power and IRS phases come from convex optimization and SDR (pp. 5-6), so learning acts above the physical layer.
notes: Excluded as above_phy. The only learned component is tabular Q-learning for the UAV trajectory (p. 6: "we apply the Q-learning algorithm to formulate C"; Algorithm 2, p. 7). The transmit power is solved with convex optimization (p. 5: "can be effectively solved using CVX tools") and the IRS reflection coefficients with Lagrangian dual transform, SDR and Gaussian randomization (p. 6), alternated by block coordinate descent (p. 5). No learned component performs a physical-layer function, so no_learning could also be argued; above_phy was chosen because the learning is part of the method and acts on the UAV trajectory, the example listed under above_phy. Benchmarks are optimization variants without learned baselines (p. 8).
